sections.text: Synthetic Harbor insurance claim policy: Submit the claim form and original receipt within thirty days of the incident.
Synthetic Harbor insurance exclusion policy: Cosmetic treatment is excluded. Emergency treatment is eligible for review.
Synthetic Harbor insurance review policy: The claims committee reviews complete applications each Monday. Appeal decisions within ten days.
Synthetic Meadow personal savings withdrawal policy: One withdrawal is permitted per quarter. Submit a withdrawal request five days in advance.
Synthetic Meadow personal savings statement policy: Statements are published on the first day of each month. Report statement errors within seven days.
Synthetic Meadow personal savings dormancy policy: Accounts become dormant after twelve months without activity. Reactivation requires an identity review.
Synthetic Cedar employee travel approval policy: Obtain manager approval before booking a trip. Keep the written approval with the itinerary.
Synthetic Cedar employee travel reimbursement policy: Submit receipts within fourteen days after returning. The finance desk reviews submissions each Friday.
Synthetic Cedar employee international travel policy: Obtain director approval for international trips. Passport validity must extend six months beyond return.
Synthetic Harbor auto insurance claim policy: Submit the vehicle claim within ten days. Include a repair estimate and incident report.
Synthetic Harbor auto insurance review policy: Vehicle applications are reviewed each Wednesday. Submit an appeal within three days.
Synthetic Harbor auto insurance exclusion policy: Normal tyre wear is excluded. Collision damage is eligible for review.
Synthetic Meadow business savings withdrawal policy: Three withdrawals are permitted per month. Requests require two business days notice.
Synthetic Meadow business savings statement policy: Statements are published on the fifteenth day of each month. Report statement errors within twenty days.
Synthetic Meadow business savings dormancy policy: Accounts become dormant after six months without activity. Reactivation requires a board resolution.
Synthetic Cedar guest travel approval policy: Obtain event coordinator approval before booking. Keep the invitation with the itinerary.
Synthetic Cedar guest travel reimbursement policy: Submit receipts within seven days after the event. The events desk reviews submissions each Tuesday.
Synthetic Cedar guest international travel policy: The event director approves international invitations. Passport validity must extend three months beyond return.
